Current manufacturer page confirms medium strength (3/5) and pure chili but has no nutrition. Bind exactly to the retained 26 g variant; do not transfer the unrelated/conflicting 28 g declaration. Supplier classification/import support for the proven variant would then be needed.
items.other: Thai peanut dishes also require roasted unsalted peanut evidence; exact-mode cabbage can remain a separate blocker.

implementation_followup.remaining: The chili_flakes branch currently checks strength in name/composition. Import and consume the already evidenced medium strength through variant-bound supplier classification; adding a nutrient row alone will not remove this separate gate. Retain dry pure-flake and exact-identity checks.
